source_term: # Non-Latin equipment words a label may carry (docs/13 §3 step b). When a label has non-Latin script
# normalize.clean_equipment_label replaces these longest-first with the English
# abbreviation / position rules run on the result. kind: equipment | position | modifier (position and
# modifier words come out as the English form the modifier table knows). "N号" is handled as "No.N" before
# this table. Non-Latin text LEFT OVER goes to the adjudicator if one is injected
# queued (reason needs_translation) — a standard key never carries non-Latin characters.
